valueNote: Timeline built from the Reuters factbox and RSSSF cap list, with the Asturias jury quotes verified verbatim. Discrepancy notes (WST future-tense body, RSSSF stopping at cap 207) are stated openly.
summary: All dated and numeric claims checked against the fetched sources. Three problems were fixed before recording: an unsupported 'as a substitute' debut detail, an unsourced '1978' mention, and an overstated 'sources disagree' sentence with a mis-cited FAQ source.
